instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React components using Tailwind CSS.
Since the target is hybrid_fullstack/Expo, simulate mobile UX with mobile-first Tailwind design (max-w-md mx-auto for desktop container, or full width with bottom navigation).
Use Phosphor Icons (or lucide-react) for medical and UI icons (e.g., FilePdf, DownloadSimple, Calculator).
Ensure 'Calculate ISA-RVG Standard Fee' button is prominent and sits next to or directly above the Anaesthesia Fees input.
Implement the math logic exactly as specified: Base + Time + ASA, then * Tier, then * 1.3 if emergency.
Case Cancelled toggle forces the logic to still calculate 100% of the standard fee (ensure UI clearly shows this override if applicable).
The Modal must have a 'Use This Amount' button that closes the modal and auto-fills the main form's Anaesthesia Fees input.
Never use fully transparent headers; use the glass_surface definition.
Ensure input contrasts meet APCA/WCAG standards. Do not use Inter for headings, strictly use Manrope.
